probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Salto&Pan ® Growth agency for online shops and software companies Services Case studies Pricing About Overview Buy Kotei Overview Buy Kotei Services Case studies Pricing About Blog Free audit Contact Halving the cost of a trial for Stige Stige's trials cost €140 each and most never paid. New campaigns, a shorter sign-up and a rebuilt landing page cut the cost in half and sent more trials to paid. Results Cost per trial -52% Trials per month +61% Trial to paid +28% Client Stige Industry Accounting software Duration 6 months Services Paid ads Conversion rate The problem Stige was spending heavily on LinkedIn to reach finance managers, at €140 per trial. Fewer than one in ten of those trials became paying customers. What we did We moved most of the budget to search, where people were already looking for accounting software, and kept LinkedIn for retargeting only. Every ad pointed to one of three landing pages, written for freelancers, small firms and accountants. The sign-up form went from nine fields to three. We tested it against the old one for a month before switching for good. The result Each trial now costs €67, and Stige gets 61% more of them every month
